about_short_description.short_description: Your e-commerce brand's product quality control department.

product.name: Quality Control Services
product.description: Provides product inspections and quality control management for e-commerce brands to ensure product standards before shipment.

identifier.value: Automated Inspection Booking and Tracking Platform

product.name: Automated Inspection Booking and Tracking Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates scheduling and tracking of product inspections by monitoring purchase order status with suppliers.

product.name: Dedicated Quality Control Team Support
product.description: Offers access to a team of quality control specialists and engineers who assist brands in optimizing inspection processes and quality standards.

product.name: Integration with Amazon and Shopify
product.description: Enables e-commerce brands to connect their Amazon or Shopify storefronts to import product catalogs and automate quality control workflows.

product.name: Production Asset Management
product.description: Centralizes storage and sharing of product assets such as logos, packaging artwork, and quality checklists to reduce communication errors.
